launchSequence.reason: Aider 0.86.2 has no native shell tool, and --yes-always deliberately refuses LLM-suggested shell commands that require explicit confirmation. The pasted prime and read-only conventions carrier still deliver startup context, but TangleClaw must not require or auto-attest tc start steps the session cannot execute.

conventionsCarrier.note: TangleClaw's rules/shared-docs/PortHub/Medusa/session-memory conventions reach Aider via its own `read:` config list (a real markdown file it loads as read-only context on every session), not as `.aider.conf.yml` comments — Aider strips `#` comments before the model ever sees them (#2439). `supportsPrimePrompt` is unrelated and still governs the separate pasted startup prime.

taskContract.note: Bounded one-shot Aider Builder task (#1644) via Aider's own `--message-file` CLI invocation, not the interactive chat loop. The runner supplies repeated `--file` arguments plus a temporary task-scoped `--aiderignore`, so `--yes-always` cannot expand the envelope when prose mentions another repo file (#2961). This entry point does not depend on the interactive wake profile.
